QF-PCR trisomy test for chromosomes 13, 18 and 21

ABNORMAL RESULT

PCR analysis of uncultured fetal tissue was carried out using markers specific for chromosomes 13, 18 and 21.

The results indicate that this fetus had TRISOMY for at least the region of CHROMOSOME 21 represented by four informative markers (D21S11 (21q21.1); D21S1409 (21q21.2); D21S1435 (21q21.3); D21S1270 (21q22.11)).  Trisomy for this region of chromosome 21 is indicative of Down syndrome.

The results for markers on chromosomes 13 and 18 are consistent with a normal complement for these chromosomes.

This confirms the prenatal diagnosis (05/10283).

Please see accompanying chromosome analysis reports.
